description: This file defines the ApiCommands class which provides CLI commands for configuring and managing the SuiteCRM V8 API, including generating keys, setting permissions, creating OAuth clients and users, and exporting Postman environments.

classes.name: ApiCommands
classes.description: A class that provides CLI commands for configuring and managing the SuiteCRM V8 API, including setting up OAuth keys, creating clients and users, and exporting environments.

methods.name: apiConfigureV8
methods.description: Configures the SuiteCRM V8 API with all defaults, including generating keys, setting permissions, creating clients and users.

methods.name: apiGenerateKeys
methods.description: Generates OAuth2 public/private key pair and stores them in specified paths.

methods.name: apiSetKeyPermissions
methods.description: Sets filesystem permissions for the OAuth2 key files.

methods.name: apiRebuildHtaccessFile
methods.description: Rebuilds the .htaccess file by including an external script.

methods.name: apiCreateClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth2 client in the SuiteCRM system with a generated secret.

methods.name: apiCreateUser
methods.description: Creates a new SuiteCRM user for the V8 API with specified credentials.

methods.name: apiExportPostmanENV
methods.description: Exports a Postman environment JSON file with API URLs for testing.

methods.name: outputClientCredentials
methods.description: Outputs OAuth client credentials in a formatted table.

methods.name: outputUserCredentials
methods.description: Outputs user credentials in a formatted table.

methods.name: getNameCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of existing records with similar names to generate unique identifiers.
